rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 2009, Zaytuna College operates as an accredited liberal arts and Islamic studies institution in Berkeley, California <cite id="4">offering undergraduate and graduate degrees</cite>. The college aims to educate intellectual and spiritual leaders grounded in Islamic scholarship <cite id="4">through a specialized curriculum</cite>. In FY2024, the institution recorded <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $18,021,649</cite>, representing roughly flat financial performance relative to recent years. Zaytuna College maintains <cite id="2">a verified zakat policy</cite> to assist eligible students through financial aid programs. However, financial efficiency allocation presents notable tradeoffs. In FY2024, the institution maintained <cite id="3">a Program expense ratio of 56.5%</cite>, leaving 43.5% allocated toward administrative and operational overhead. This ratio is below the industry standard benchmark of 75% and sits well under the peer median of 93.7% for similar religious and cultural organizations. Additionally, the organization holds significant liquidity, with approximately 33.6 months of working capital held in reserve. While the college demonstrates verified outcome tracking and strong academic governance, its lower program expense allocation and substantial reserve holdings present an overall balanced assessment for prospective donors.
